versos.grego: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ὑπὲρ τῆς παρουσίας τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡμῶν ἐπισυναγωγῆς ἐπ’ αὐτόν,

controles.web: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together to him, we ask you
controles.kjv: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
controles.livre: Ora irmãos, nós vos rogamos quanto à vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, e à nossa reunião com ele,

versos.grego: εἰς τὸ μὴ ταχέως σαλευθῆναι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ νοὸς μηδὲ θροεῖσθαι μήτε διὰ πνεύματος μήτε διὰ λόγου μήτε δι’ ἐπιστολῆς ὡς δι’ ἡμῶν, ὡς ὅτι ἐνέστηκεν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ Κυρίου.

controles.web: not to be quickly shaken in your mind, nor yet be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by letter as from us, saying that the day of Christ had come.
controles.kjv: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
controles.livre: Que vós não vos abaleis facilmente em vosso entendimento, e não vos perturbeis, nem por espírito, nem por palavra, nem por carta como que escrita por nós, como se o dia de Cristo já estivesse perto.

versos.grego: μή τις ὑμᾶς ἐξαπατήσῃ κατὰ μηδένα τρόπον· ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ ἔλθῃ ἡ ἀποστασία πρῶτον καὶ ἀποκαλυφθῇ ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας, ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας,

controles.web: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be, unless the departure comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction,
controles.kjv: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
controles.livre: Ninguém vos engane em maneira nenhuma; porque não virá esse dia sem que primeiro venha a apostasia,  e se manifeste o homem da injustiça,  o filho da perdição.

versos.grego: ὁ ἀντικείμενος καὶ ὑπεραιρόμενος ἐπὶ πάντα λεγόμενον Θεὸν ἢ σέβασμα, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ καθίσαι, ἀποδεικνύντα ἑαυτὸν ὅτι ἔστιν Θεός.

controles.web: he who opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped; so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
controles.kjv: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
controles.livre: O qual se opõe e se levanta sobre tudo o que se chama Deus, ou sobre tudo que é adorado; por isso ele se sentará no templo de Deus,  fazendo-se parecer Deus.

versos.grego: Οὐ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ἔτι ὢν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ταῦτα ἔλεγον ὑμῖν;

controles.web: Don’t you remember that, when I was still with you, I told you these things?
controles.kjv: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
controles.livre: Não vos lembrais, que enquanto ainda estava convosco, eu vos dizia estas coisas?

versos.grego: καὶ νῦν τὸ κατέχον οἴδατε, εἰς τὸ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ αὐτοῦ καιρῷ.

controles.web: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
controles.kjv: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
controles.livre: E agora sabeis o que o detém, para que a seu próprio tempo seja manifestado.

versos.grego: τὸ γὰρ μυστήριον ἤδη ἐνεργεῖται τῆς ἀνομίας· μόνον ὁ κατέχων ἄρτι ἕως ἐκ μέσου γένηται.

controles.web: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
controles.kjv: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
controles.livre: Porque o mistério da injustiça já opera; só há aquele que agora o detém, até que seja tirado do meio.

versos.grego: καὶ τότε ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ὁ ἄνομος, ὃν ὁ Κύριος Ἰησοῦς ἀνελεῖ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ καταργήσει τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth, and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;
controles.kjv: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
controles.livre: E então será manifestado aquele injusto, ao qual o Senhor destruirá, pelo sopro de sua boca, e o aniquilará pelo aparecimento de sua vinda;

versos.grego: οὗ ἐστιν ἡ παρουσία κατ’ ἐνέργειαν τοῦ Σατανᾶ ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει καὶ σημείοις καὶ τέρασιν ψεύδους

controles.web: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
controles.kjv: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
controles.livre: Aquele injusto cuja vinda é conforme o agir de Satanás, com todo poder, e sinais, e milagres falsos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν πάσῃ ἀπάτῃ ἀδικίας τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις, ἀνθ’ ὧν τὴν ἀγάπην τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἐδέξαντο εἰς τὸ σωθῆναι αὐτούς.

controles.web: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
controles.kjv: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
controles.livre: E com todo engano de injustiça nos que perecem; porque não receberam o amor da verdade para se salvarem.

versos.grego: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο πέμπει αὐτοῖς ὁ Θεὸς ἐνέργειαν πλάνης εἰς τὸ πιστεῦσαι αὐτοὺς τῷ ψεύδει,

controles.web: Because of this, God sends them a working of error, that they should believe a lie;
controles.kjv: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
controles.livre: E por isso Deus lhes enviará a ação do erro, para que creiam na mentira.

versos.grego: ἵνα κριθῶσιν πάντες οἱ μὴ πιστεύσαντες τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ἀλλὰ εὐδοκήσαντες τῇ ἀδικίᾳ.

controles.web: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
controles.kjv: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
controles.livre: Para que sejam condenados todos os que não creram na verdade, mas tiveram prazer na injustiça.

versos.grego: Ἡμεῖς δὲ ὀφείλομεν εὐχαριστεῖν τῷ Θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ Κυρίου, ὅτι εἵλατο ὑμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς εἰς σωτηρίαν ἐν ἁγιασμῷ Πνεύματος καὶ πίστει ἀληθείας,

controles.web: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth;
controles.kjv: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
controles.livre: Mas sempre devemos dar graças a Deus por vós, irmãos, que sois amados pelo Senhor, pois Deus vos escolheu desde o princípio para a salvação, em santificação do Espírito, e fé na verdade;

versos.grego: εἰς ὃ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὑμᾶς διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἡμῶν, εἰς περιποίησιν δόξης τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Para a qual ele vos chamou por meio do nosso Evangelho, para a obtenção da glória de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Ἄρα οὖν, ἀδελφοί, στήκετε, καὶ κρατεῖτε τὰς παραδόσεις ἃς ἐδιδάχθητε εἴτε διὰ λόγου εἴτε δι’ ἐπιστολῆς ἡμῶν.

controles.web: So then, brothers, stand firm, and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word, or by letter.
controles.kjv: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
controles.livre: Portanto, irmãos, ficai firmes, e retende as tradições que vos foram ensinadas, seja por palavra, seja por carta nossa.

versos.grego: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ὁ Πατὴρ ἡμῶν, ὁ ἀγαπήσας ἡμᾶς καὶ δοὺς παράκλησιν αἰωνίαν καὶ ἐλπίδα ἀγαθὴν ἐν χάριτι,

controles.web: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
controles.kjv: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
controles.livre: E ele mesmo, o nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, e nosso Deus e Pai, que nos amou e em graça nos deu uma eterna consolação e boa esperança;

versos.grego: παρακαλέσαι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας καὶ στηρίξαι ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ ἀγαθῷ.

controles.web: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
controles.kjv: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
controles.livre: Ele console vossos corações, e vos fortaleça em toda boa palavra e obra.
